shared_elements: anthropomorphic upper body with garment or belt detail
justification: Both depict a human figure with a rendered head and upper body, but that is a near-universal subject; A is a fully three-dimensional, extremely schematic standing pillar-figure with featureless face, tubular body and hands meeting at the waist, while B is a single naturalistic profile bust with carefully modelled eye, nose, ear, elaborately curled beard and hair, patterned headgear and detailed drapery. Nothing beyond the generic 'human figure' is shared: no shared posture, attributes, framing or rendering conventions, and the modes of depiction (frontal blocky sculpture in the round versus profile low relief with dense patterned infill) are opposite.
